title: Dickson's Conjecture on Simultaneous Prime Values of Linear Forms
exact_target: Must every locally admissible finite family of positive-slope linear forms produce simultaneous primes arbitrarily often?

sources.citation: Shaohua Zhang, Notes on Dickson's Conjecture, arXiv:0906.3850v3 (2009).
An exposition on the supersimplicity of certain expansions of the additive group of the integers.
